purpose: Declarative single-writer / phase-order contract for the SU -> DOC -> generator -> QA materialization chain. Replaces the multi-actor offer/acceptance/admission/receipt ceremony with one digest-verifiable JSON artifact, so LANE-DOC's SU-side precondition is evaluable from repository state alone.
phase_order_semantics: Strictly ordered. A phase may begin only after every earlier phase has status 'complete'. No phase may write a path owned by another phase.

pass_constraint.rule: Exactly ONE admitted doc-sync generator pass may write these paths. Additional passes are contract violations.

writer_map_invariants.rule: The write sets of SU_PUBLISH, DOC_CONSUME, GENERATE and SU_QA are pairwise disjoint; every listed path has exactly one owning phase.

no_forward_output_claim.statement: This contract makes NO claim about the outcome, content, or success of DOC_CONSUME, GENERATE or SU_QA. Those phases are declared pending with null evidence and are LANE-DOC / generator work, not SU work. Only SU_PUBLISH is claimed complete, and that claim is backed by recomputable sha256 evidence over live bytes.

tracked_eligible_evidence.git_check_ignore_note: No .gitignore rule matches docs/reference/mat-doc10-writer-order.v2.json, so /commit can stage it and a fresh clone will contain it.

durability.superseded_draft_status: non-authoritative evidence — preserved byte-for-byte, never amended, never deleted; it lives under the gitignored docs/dev/ tree (.gitignore:142) and is therefore unstageable and absent from a fresh clone
durability.rationale: The v2 contract was first drafted at docs/dev/mat-doc10-writer-order-contract.v2.json, which .gitignore:142 excludes. LANE-DOC's gate and the goal(b)/M1 word 'durable' both require an artifact that survives /commit and a fresh clone, so the authoritative home moved to this git-tracked path. Consumers MUST bind to contract_path; the draft is retained only so the iteration-1 QA evidence chain stays resolvable.

lane_doc_precondition.description: The SU-side precondition LANE-DOC must satisfy before dispatching P2 (DOC_CONSUME). Evaluable from repository state alone.
predicate: every SU_PUBLISH.evidence.file_sha256 entry equals the sha256 of the live worktree file
lane_doc_precondition.note: No step of this evaluation reads any path under docs/dev/overnight/*/cycle-1/. The predicate is satisfiable with every ceremony artifact treated as nonexistent. The SU_PUBLISH.evidence.qa_report pointer is provenance, not a gate input: it is deliberately excluded from this predicate so the gate stays evaluable from tracked repository state alone.

The SUBSTANTIVE obligation it carried (single writer per path, SU -> DOC -> generator -> QA order) survives and is re-published here in plain Claude-harness form.
